claim_boundary: Static sidecar assembled from committed receipts. No new GPU probe. Every GB/s is copied from a named prior receipt with its statistic and provenance caveat. The 703 GB/s addr-probe loads scales + packed codes and sinks them; NO NIBBLE UNPACK, NO INPUT-VECTOR LOAD, NO FMA — it never loads the activation and is NOT comparable to any kernel that does. 819 is the datasheet peak; DeltaNet ARM A 943.2 exceeds it by 1.15x and is residency, not a DRAM streaming target. evidence_class SELF_MEASURED_DIRTY on a contaminated host qualifies nothing. A TPS figure here is never labelled QUALIFIED; a protected window is still required. Bit-identical output is non-negotiable.

finding: 703.6 is an addr-probe without an input-vector load (median 699.57). First target is production_catalog_401_gemvs 530.7 (max 539.0, min 509.3). Honest MLP ceiling WITH activation is ARM A 497.4. Production affine2-q2 is 329.6. fold_addqx is the demonstrated removable 1.127x bit-identical decode cheapen (370.9). production_effective is 337.3 across the token. 819 is datasheet; 943.2 DeltaNet ARM A is residency, not DRAM. Granularity, catalog addressing, dispatch count, decode fusion, stream count, dependency chains, register pressure, and occupancy are REFUTED. A protected window is still required; no TPS is QUALIFIED.

refuted.claim: fragmented regions / packing granularity is why MLP sits at ~330 GB/s
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: GRANULARITY_REFUTED: One layer's MLP, packed into one staging buffer and executed in one serial compute region, stayed near the ~350 GB/s cluster. The granularity / fragmentation hypothesis is DEAD. Do not rescue it with more packing variants.

refuted.claim: host catalog indirection / unhoisted addressing is the 703→530 tax
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: CATALOG_ADDRESSING falsified_as=host catalog indirection on the GPU addr-probe timestamp. FALSIFIED as catalog-indirection / unhoisted host addressing on the GPU timestamp. 401 production-shaped GEMVs cost ~15 us/dispatch against one 13.6 GB GEMV; tiled identical large gates sit in between (591 GB/s). Device addressing is already a direct load. The crate change hoists getenv / groups_per_row / last-hit pipeline lookup off the token loop (DSV4F scar). That does not close 703→530.

refuted.claim: raw dispatch count is the main 703→530 / 530→337 mechanism
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: Same 13.612 GB, 1 vs 401 vs 287 tiled gates: extra dispatch is ~12–16 µs. Encoder collapse (serial vs noop) left GPU_NS overlapping. KERNEL_GEOMETRY: weight-free dispatches at most 0.586 ms of the token. Dispatch count is not the named loss.

refuted.claim: fusing decode launches (encoder collapse / more fusion) recovers the band
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: CATALOG_ADDRESSING encoder_collapse: serial encoder is token-identical and does not separate GPU_NS. Production already runs GateUpSwiglu + GQA-QKV + DN-inproj + add-RMSNorm on the 580-graph (DELTANET_WIDEN_AB). Fusion is not the remaining lever.

refuted.claim: MLP is stream-count bound; merging 2+2+2 into 4+2 then 6 recovers GB/s
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: MLP_STREAM_COUNT: 4+2 shape dn_4_2_32=377.1 GB/s is only 1.2232x the 2+2+2 shape mlp_2_2_2_32=308.3; merging further HURTS (pack_6_32=218.7 GB/s, pack_38=45.6). Verdict MIXED; do not force STREAM_COUNT_BOUND.

refuted.claim: MLP is dependency-bound; more accumulator chains recover the ARM A gap
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: MLP_ISSUE_RATE_LADDER ILP: 1-to-8 accumulator chains span 1.062 (jumped=False, bar 1.12). Not DEPENDENCY_BOUND.

refuted.claim: register pressure is why production sits at 330 GB/s
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: MLP_ISSUE_RATE_LADDER register_pressure: ws0 308.3 vs ws32 332.4 GB/s, span 1.0782, occupancy_span 1.0, dropped=False. Span 1.078 does not explain 1.51x ARM A.

refuted.claim: raising occupancy (more threads per threadgroup) recovers the band
refuted.refutation_or_demonstration: Raising occupancy makes things WORSE. issue-ladder tg1024 (1024 threads/threadgroup) is 236.09670091208082 GB/s against production-occupancy 128 threads at ~308–330 GB/s. KERNEL_GEOMETRY: tpr64 already covers every production organ except BA with dozens to thousands of threadgroups per core; occupancy/tails are not the 530→337 drop.

removable.claim: production affine2-q2 decode arithmetic (8 dequant FMA + 8 MAC per 6 B)
removable.refutation_or_demonstration: fold_addqx is bit-identical by byte comparison of output buffers, 370.9 GB/s vs this-run production 329.2 (1.1265x, obligation's 1.127x). Closes 0.2477 of the ARM A 497.4 gap on the one-layer probe. DIRTY_DIAGNOSTIC until the complete-token A/B. A faster resident that answers differently is not the same resident.

rungs.provenance: A paper peak, not a streaming measurement. DeltaNet ARM A 943.2 GB/s exceeds it by 1.15x and therefore cannot be a DRAM streaming rate — treat 943.2 as residency, not a target.

Median of the same probe is 699.574 GB/s; min 693.151. 703.6 is the max.

Same addr-probe kernel as the 703 figure, 401 production-shaped GEMVs, 13.612 GB payload. Still no activation load. This is the obligation's already-measured floor of what this machine does through the catalog, and the first target. CATALOG_ADDRESSING falsified host catalog indirection as the 703→530 mechanism; the drop is dispatch topology + mixed organ sizes.

A real streaming rate WITH the activation load. Honest ceiling for the MLP shape. Not occupancy-limited. ARM A jumped 1.51x vs production 329.6; ARM B tracked bytes so the conjunction stayed MIXED, but surviving loads + ARM A near the LM-head rate (497.4) is the ceiling fold_addqx is climbing toward.

structural.claim: 703 addr-probe is the production decode ceiling
structural.refutation_or_demonstration: The probe does not load the activation and does not FMA. ARM A at 497.4 WITH the activation load is the honest MLP ceiling. Comparing 703 to 337 is comparing different work.

structural.claim: 401 mixed production-shaped GEMVs vs one 13.612 GB GEMV
structural.refutation_or_demonstration: Falsified as catalog-indirection. Remaining named cost is dispatch topology + mixed organ sizes (single max 703.6 → catalog median 530.7). Not host addressing. First target is still the 530 catalog floor, then 703.

structural.claim: kernel geometry / occupancy / coalescing is the 530→337 drop
structural.refutation_or_demonstration: tpr64 covers every production organ with dropped=0 and, except BA, dozens to thousands of threadgroups per core. The 530->337 GB/s drop is the byte numerator (affine MLP vs all-q4 catalog of the same shapes) plus a few milliseconds of non-GEMV work. Catalog addressing already used this occupancy class. Affine MLP is denser than the all-q4 catalog of the same shapes; production also pays non-GEMV work (DeltaNet, GQA, rmsnorm, swiglu). That is not removable decode arithmetic.

structural.claim: 819 datasheet or 943 DeltaNet ARM A is the streaming target
structural.refutation_or_demonstration: DeltaNet ARM A 943.2 exceeds datasheet 819.0 by 1.15x; that cannot be DRAM streaming. 819 is a paper peak. Neither is a target for recovering the weight-addressing band.
